data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 1.1m (2015: run-off deviation of GBP 0.4m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012 and 2013 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a GBP 1.1 million release in prior year reserves, attributed to favourable run-off deviation on the 2012 and 2013 years of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts. This represents a 1.35% release relative to the opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: reserve movements on the 2012 and 2013 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of GBP 1.1m is explicitly stated as a 'favourable run-off deviation' in Note 9, but it is not specified if this amount is gross or net of reinsurance. Given the absence of a gross/net breakdown in the note, and common reporting practices, it is assumed to be a net figure. The claims development triangle on page 14 does not provide the current year's (2016) estimates per underwriting year, making it unsuitable for calculating the 2016 prior year development using the specified method.
